content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the TabletServer not having a configurable mechanism to handle failures when creating Write-Ahead Logs (WALs) in HDFS. Specifically, if the number of failures exceeded a hardcoded limit (5), the TabletServer would terminate without allowing for any configuration to adjust this limit or the time period over which these failures were counted. The patch introduced new configuration properties to allow users to specify the maximum number of tolerated WAL creation failures and the time period for counting these failures, thus providing more flexibility and preventing premature termination of the TabletServer due to transient HDFS issues.

buggy_stmts_infos.buggy_stmt: -  // Die if we get 5 WAL creation errors in 10 seconds
